name: Pipeliners - Audits and Notes 2026-06-18
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-06-18

# Summary
Rollup of five June 2026 working notes: a GHL attribution audit, a Search bid strategy review, an OTTO schema fix SOP, a Search Atlas support ticket draft and a task verification pass. All read-only; Google Ads changes were written as recommendations for Kim to apply.

# Key findings
- GHL attribution audit (Jun 18): Search was not losing credit to Performance Max through cannibalization. The real issue was a conversion-goal misconfiguration: actions that fire on Search clicks were excluded from the Conversions column. Last 30 days: Search spent $1,817 with 7.0 all conversions but 1 reported; pMax spent $1,142 with 9.0 all conversions and 2 reported. The GHL offline import had effectively stalled (last uploads May 26 to Jun 12). GCLID capture at form submit was working.
- Search bid review (Jun 18): only "Search campaign feb 2026" (Maximize Conversions, no target, $60 a day) was spending; the AI Max twin was dormant. Recommendation: extend the hold and fix the conversion mapping first, then wait 5 to 7 days before reviewing bids.
- OTTO schema fix (Jun 5, approved by Scott): OTTO was deploying "Course" schema on city pages. SOP: delete Course, generate and deploy Service. Done on 14 priority cities; 22 long-tail cities remaining at the time.
- Support ticket draft (Jun 18): asks Search Atlas to stop suggesting Course and to allow locking schema type per template; /hydro-jetting/ and /pipelining-myths-debunked/ still had Course.
- Task verification (Jun 18): city pages had moved to flat /{city}/ URLs (/service-areas/{city}/ now 301s), so earlier indexing requests targeted redirects. Sitemap exclusion problem resolved. FAQ sections live on 21 of 38 city pages; about 14% of images missing alt; Service schema live on 12 of 14 priority cities.
